---
name: Naming dispute
about: A canonical name, alias, or attribution is wrong or unsupported
title: "[naming] <slug>: "
labels: naming-dispute
---

<!--
Read CONTRIBUTING.md first. A naming claim is decided on written
evidence: a book, an encyclopaedia entry, an article, or a dated game.
Do not attach a CSV diff; the catalogue is never hand-edited.
-->

**Slug**
<!-- The OCN-1 slug, e.g. B.Sic.Naj. One dispute per issue. -->

**Which field is wrong**
<!-- canonical_name / aliases / attributed_to / attribution_source /
     historical_notes / notes. Quote the current value verbatim. -->

**Claimed correct value**
<!-- What the field should say, exactly as you would have it written. -->

**Written source**
<!-- Author, work, year, page (or URL and retrieval date). Quote the
     sentence that carries the claim. If your source is a game rather
     than a statement, say so: a game proves that a line was played and
     when, never what it is named after. -->

- Author:
- Work:
- Year:
- Page or URL:
- Quoted claim:

**Did you read the source first-hand?**
<!-- Yes / No. A search summary or an AI paraphrase of a source is not
     the source, and will not be accepted as one. -->

**Anything that argues against your claim**
<!-- Conflicting attestations, a competing eponym, an earlier practitioner.
     Optional but valued: it is usually what decides the case. -->
